name: Falcon Top Gym
address: 7CQ5+V7W - Al Qusais Ind. Fifth - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

reviews.author: Preetha Nair-Sachin
reviews.text:
The gym has a huge variety of equipment in good working order, as well as a wide range of free weights. It’s clean and well maintained. The atmosphere is very welcoming, with staff always on hand to help should you need it. They also have classes like MMA, kickboxing and karate for both kids and adults.
I signed up for the personal training program, and a special shout out to my trainer Joshi. He is very knowledgeable, friendly and supportive. His experience in personal training can be clearly seen in the manner in which he adapts the workout to each person, and he knows just how much to push you to do your best, never compromising on form.
I highly recommend this gym.

I highly recommend this gym and Trainer Joshi to anyone looking to improve their fitness.

reviews.author: arjun tc
reviews.text:
I can’t say enough great things about Falcon Top Gym! From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed into a friendly and motivating environment. The gym is always neat, clean, and well-organized, which makes every workout comfortable and enjoyable.
The equipment is brand new, modern, and top quality. They have a wide variety of machines for every muscle group, plenty of free weights, and well-maintained cardio machines. Everything is arranged perfectly, making it easy to move around without feeling crowded. The machines run smoothly, the weights are in excellent condition, and you can tell the management truly invests in high-standard equipment for members’ safety and performance.
A special shoutout to the head coach — incredibly friendly, professional, and supportive. They take the time to guide and encourage everyone, no matter your fitness level. Their positive attitude, expert knowledge, and hands-on approach really help you improve and stay motivated.
Highly recommend Falcon Top Gym to anyone looking for a super clean facility, brand-new equipment, and outstanding coaching in a welcoming atmosphere! 💪
